usdRate.sourceName: World Bank WDI PA.NUS.FCRF (Timor-Leste uses the US dollar)
usdRate.note: The US dollar is legal tender; BCTL issues only centavo coins.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Banco Central de Timor-Leste inflation report (national CPI compiled by the statistics office)
inflation_cpi.note: Timor-Leste CPI year-on-year -0.08% in August 2026 (index 125.5); 0.48% in July. Dili CPI was +0.41%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: BCTL CPI history: 5.3% (Dec 2021), 6.9% (2022), 8.7% (2023), -0.4% (2024), 1.0% (2025); US dollar is the legal currency
inflation_projection.note: Timor-Leste uses the US dollar, so long-run inflation should track US inflation plus import costs; the 2021-2025 average (about 4%) is inflated by the 2022-23 shock, so we plan with 3%.

policy_rate.note: Timor-Leste uses the US dollar and BCTL sets no policy interest rate; searched BCTL statistics and mandate pages.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: Banco Central de Timor-Leste, Table 10 Commercial Bank Interest Rate (saving deposit)
savings_account_rate.note: Average commercial bank savings deposit rate 0.47% in August 2026.

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: Banco Central de Timor-Leste, Table 10 Commercial Bank Interest Rate (3-month time deposit)
fdr_3m_rate.note: Average 3-month time deposit rate 0.42% in August 2026 (0.54% in June).

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: Banco Central de Timor-Leste, Table 10 Commercial Bank Interest Rate (12-month time deposit)
fdr_1y_rate.note: Average 12-month time deposit rate 0.46% in August 2026, down from 0.68% in June.

dps_rate.note: No monthly recurring deposit product rate appears in BCTL Table 10 or the BCTL interest-rates-by-bank publications.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: World Bank WDI FR.INR.DPST (deposit interest rate)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: BCTL Table 10 has no single weighted average across all deposits; time deposit rates were 0.42-0.46% in August 2026.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found in BCTL publications.

tbill_91d_rate.note: No domestic treasury bill market was found in BCTL statistics; the state finances itself mainly from the Petroleum Fund.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No domestic government bond market was found in BCTL statistics.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No domestic government bond market was found in BCTL statistics.

tax_bank_interest.note: The tax authority and Ministry of Finance tax pages could not be read (site unreachable or script-only); no withholding rate on bank interest was confirmed.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate exists, so no tax rule applies; searched BCTL and Ministry of Finance pages.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: No deposit insurance scheme was found in BCTL laws, statistics or consumer protection pages.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: BCTL Table 10 reports only loan rates (7.5% average in August 2026); no credit card rate or legal cap was found.

equity_return_low.sourceName: No local stock exchange; global equity index in US dollars; BCTL Table 10, commercial bank 12-month time deposit rate 0.46% (August 2026)
equity_return_low.note: Low case for a global index fund held in US dollars after weak decades for world shares.

equity_return_base.sourceName: No local stock exchange; global equity index in US dollars; BCTL Table 10, commercial bank 12-month time deposit rate 0.46% (August 2026)
equity_return_base.note: There is no local stock market, so the base is a global index in US dollars, capped at the 0.46% safe deposit rate plus under 4 points.

equity_return_high.sourceName: No local stock exchange; global equity index in US dollars; BCTL Table 10, commercial bank 12-month time deposit rate 0.46% (August 2026)
equity_return_high.note: High case near the long-run nominal return of world equities in US dollars.

gold_return_low.sourceName: US dollar is the legal currency (World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF = 1)
gold_return_low.note: Low case for gold in US dollars, with no currency depreciation effect.

gold_return_base.sourceName: US dollar is the legal currency (World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF = 1)
gold_return_base.note: Base case equals the long-run US dollar gold trend of about 4%, since there is no local currency to depreciate.

gold_return_high.sourceName: US dollar is the legal currency (World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF = 1)
gold_return_high.note: High case with strong dollar gold prices.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: BCTL Table 10, commercial bank 12-month time deposit rate 0.46% (August 2026)
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: savings or short deposits if rates keep falling (the 12-month rate fell from 0.68% to 0.46% in mid-2026).

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: BCTL Table 10, commercial bank 12-month time deposit rate 0.46% (August 2026)
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: local term deposits around 0.4-0.5%; tax on interest not confirmed, so kept just below the gross rate.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: BCTL Table 10, commercial bank 12-month time deposit rate 0.46% (August 2026)
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: 6-12 month deposits back at the 2024-25 level of about 0.6-0.7%.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: BCTL insurance statistics page carries no claim settlement ratio; none found elsewhere.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No published term life premium rates for Timor-Leste were found; the insurance market is very small.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical private hospital bill was found; public hospital care is largely free.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premium table for Timor-Leste was found.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: BCTL CPI series (no medical sub-index published in the BCTL report)
goal_inflation_health.note: No medical CPI is published, so we plan with the 3% headline projection plus one point.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: BCTL CPI series (no education sub-index published in the BCTL report)
goal_inflation_education.note: No education CPI is published, so we plan with the 3% headline projection plus half a point.

life_expectancy.note: UN WPP 2024 (via populationpyramid.net) gives 68.3 for 2026 (men 66.7, women 70.1).

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 8.48 (2025, World Bank), 8.8 (2040) and 17.4 (2065, populationpyramid.net/timor-leste/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Tatoli (national news agency): Civil Service Commission explains retirement rules
retirement_age_default.note: The social security regime (Law 12/2016) gives old-age rights from age 60, the same for men and women.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: Tatoli (national news agency): Civil Service Commission explains retirement rules
retirement_age_government.note: Mandatory retirement for civil servants at 65; retirement on request possible from 60 to 64.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: BCTL Table 10, commercial bank 12-month time deposit rate 0.46% (August 2026)
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: savings deposits if rates keep falling.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: BCTL Table 10, commercial bank 12-month time deposit rate 0.46% (August 2026)
retirement_return_base.note: Base case kept just below the 0.46% average 1-year deposit rate, the best safe rate available locally.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: BCTL Table 10, commercial bank 12-month time deposit rate 0.46% (August 2026)
retirement_return_high.note: High case: 6-12 month deposits back at about 0.6%.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Mix of local deposits (0.46%) and global equity in US dollars
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix mostly in near-zero local deposits.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Mix of local deposits (0.46%) and global equity in US dollars
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: half local deposits at about 0.4% and half a global equity fund at 4%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Mix of local deposits (0.46%) and global equity in US dollars
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case with a larger, well-performing global equity share.

old_age_allowance_monthly.sourceName: Tatoli (national news agency): INSS plans monthly payments for elderly and disabled
old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Social pension US$60 a month at 60-69, US$80 at 70-79 and US$100 at 80+ (Tatoli, 10 January 2024 and 22 February 2024).

old_age_allowance_eligibility.sourceName: Tatoli (national news agency): Government adjusts the social pension for the disabled and elderly
old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Social pension (replaced SAII) from 60 with higher rates at 70 and 80; it cannot be combined with income from work, per Tatoli 22 February 2024.

gratuity_rule.note: No statutory retirement gratuity for private employees was found; retirement income runs through INSS.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Tatoli (national news agency): INSS contributions and the social security regime
public_pension_scheme.note: Contributory INSS scheme under Law 12/2016: 4% employee plus 6% employer; old-age pension from 60 (Tatoli 20 July 2026). No automatic indexation rule was confirmed.

dps.note: No monthly recurring deposit product found in BCTL publications.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate or retail bond found.

equity_fund.note: No local stock exchange or locally offered mutual funds found.

gold.note: No legal restriction on buying gold was found; mainly sold as jewellery.

insuranceRegulator.name: Banco Central de Timor-Leste (licenses and supervises insurers)

insuranceComplaints.name: Banco Central de Timor-Leste consumer protection

pensionScheme.name: Instituto Nacional de Segurança Social (INSS), under the Ministry of Social Solidarity and Inclusion
pensionScheme.note: The INSS website (segurancasocial.gov.tl) showed only a placeholder page in October 2026.

oldAgeAllowance.name: Social pension for the elderly and disabled (paid by INSS)
